title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the upper bound of the lowest s-state energy.

title: Trial Wave Function
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the hydrogenic wave function as the trial function.

title: Energy Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct steps in calculating the expectation value of the Hamiltonian using the trial wave function.

title: Critical Point Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the condition for the minimum energy by taking the derivative of the energy with respect to k.

title: Disregarding k=0
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and discard the solution k=0 as non-physical.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms in the energy expression have consistent units.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors in the energy calculation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing factors in the final expression for energy.
